verses.en: Elihu also proceeded, and said,
verses.sm: Eliu,

verses.en: Suffer me a little, and I will shew thee that I have yet to speak on God's behalf.
verses.sm: Ia e onosai mai pea teisi ia te au, ou te faaali atu ai ia te oe, aua ua totoe pea upu mo le Atua.

verses.en: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
verses.sm: Ou te aumaia loʻu poto ai le mea mamao, ou te tauamiotonuina foi le na faia au.

verses.en: For truly my words shall not be false: he that is perfect in knowledge is with thee.
verses.sm: Auā e moni O upu a Eliu lava, e le pepelo aʻu upu; ua ia te oe le tasi ua faamaoni lona poto.

verses.en: Behold, God is mighty, and despiseth not any: he is mighty in strength and wisdom.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua silisili ese le Atua, a e le ʻinoʻino o ia i se tasi, ua silisili ese le malosi o lona finagalo.

verses.en: He preserveth not the life of the wicked: but giveth right to the poor.
verses.sm: Na te le faaola i le ua amio leaga; a e faia e ia le faamasinoga mo e ua puapuagatia.

verses.en: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: but with kings are they on the throne; yea, he doth establish them for ever, and they are exalted.
verses.sm: Na te le ʻalo ona fofoga i e ua amiotonu; a e silasila i tupu i nofoālii; na te faatumauina foi i latou e faavavau, ua faasilisiliina foi i latou.

verses.en: And if they be bound in fetters, and be holden in cords of affliction;
verses.sm: Afai foi ua noanoatia i latou i maea uamea, ma lavelavea i latou i maea o le puapuaga,

verses.en: Then he sheweth them their work, and their transgressions that they have exceeded.
verses.sm: ona faaali ai lea e ia ia te i latou o mea ua latou faia, ma o latou solitulafono, ina ua tele lava.

verses.en: He openeth also their ear to discipline, and commandeth that they return from iniquity.
verses.sm: Ua ia faafaalogoina foi o latou taliga i aoaiga; ma fetalai atu, ia latou foi mai nai le amio leaga.

verses.en: If they obey and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.
verses.sm: Afai latou te faalogo ma auauna ia te ia, ona faauma ai lea o latou aso o manuia, ma o latou tausaga o fiafia.

verses.en: But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge.
verses.sm: A e afai latou te le faalogo, ona faaumatia ai lea o i latou ile tao, e oti foi i latou e le popoto.

verses.en: But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: they cry not when he bindeth them.
verses.sm: A o e ua loto faalematau, ua latou faaputuina le toasa; latou te le alalaga ia te ia pe a noanoatia i latou e ia.

verses.en: They die in youth, and their life is among the unclean.
verses.sm: E oti i latou a o taulelea; e iu foi o latou ola faatasi ma e ua faasotoma.

verses.en: He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression.
verses.sm: Na te laveaiina le ua puapuagatia nai lona puapuaga; na te faafaalogoina foi o latou taliga a o sauaina i latou.

verses.en: Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait into a broad place, where there is no straitness; and that which should be set on thy table should be full of fatness.
verses.sm: E faapea foi ona ia taʻitaʻieseina o oe ai le mea va apiapi i le mea lautele e le o i ai se va apiapi; o le mea foi e laulauina i lau laoai e soona lololo lea.

verses.en: But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked: judgment and justice take hold on thee.
verses.sm: A ua e faaatoatoaina le faamasinoga a e amio leaga; e mulimuli le faasala i le faamasinoga.

verses.en: Because there is wrath, beware lest he take thee away with his stroke: then a great ransom cannot deliver thee.
verses.sm: Aua ua i ai le toasa, ia oe, rie’i aveesea oe e ia i le sasa; ona le faasaoina ai lea oe i se togiola tele.

verses.en: Will he esteem thy riches? no, not gold, nor all the forces of strength.
verses.sm: Na te finagalo ea i au oloa? Na te le finagalo lava i auro, po o faulaigáoa uma lava.

verses.en: Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place.
verses.sm: Aua e te manao i le po, e avae ai nuu a: le mea o loo latou i ai.

verses.en: Take heed, regard not iniquity: for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.
verses.sm: la oe, neʻi e loto atu i le amio leaga; aua ua sili lou loto i lea mea i lou loto i le puapuaga.

verses.en: Behold, God exalteth by his power: who teacheth like him?
verses.sm: Faauta, ua silisili ese le Atua i lona malosi; o ai na te aʻoaʻo e faapei o ia?

verses.en: Who hath enjoined him his way? or who can say, Thou hast wrought iniquity?
verses.sm: po o ai ua togia ia te ia lona ala? o ai foi na te fai atu, Ua e faia amioletonu?

verses.en: Remember that thou magnify his work, which men behold.
verses.sm: la e manatuz ona vivii i ana galuega o loo vaai i ai tagata;

verses.en: Every man may see it; man may behold it afar off.
verses.sm: ua matamata i ai tagata uma lava, ua iloa mamao atu e tagata.

verses.en: Behold, God is great, and we know him not, neither can the number of his years be searched out.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua silisili ese le Atua, tatou te le iloa foi o ia; e le masino foi le faitau o ona tausaga.

verses.en: For he maketh small the drops of water: they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof:
verses.sm: Aua e aveina ae e ia faaafuafu o vai; e totò ifo le ua e sui a'i lona ausa,

verses.en: Which the clouds do drop and distil upon man abundantly.
verses.sm: e mauluulu mai ai i ao; e totò tele mai ai i luga o tagata.

verses.en: Also can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, or the noise of his tabernacle?
verses.sm: E iloa foi ea se tasi ona fofola o le ao, ma le taalili mai o lona fale apitaga?

verses.en: Behold, he spreadeth his light upon it, and covereth the bottom of the sea.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua ia fofola i ona luga lona malamalama; ua ia ufiufi foi le iliti tai.

verses.en: For by them judgeth he the people; he giveth meat in abundance.
verses.sm: Aua o ia mea ua ia faasalaina ai nuu; ua ia foai mai ai foi mea e ‘ai e tee.

verses.en: With clouds he covereth the light; and commandeth it not to shine by the cloud that cometh betwixt.
verses.sm: Ua ia ufitia ona aao i le uila, na te poloai i ai i se mea e pal iai.

verses.en: The noise thereof sheweth concerning it, the cattle also concerning the vapour.
verses.sm: Ua ia faailoa mai lona faititili i luga o tagata, i luga o lafu atoa ma mea e tutupu.
